description: This source file defines the ElasticLoadBalancingClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Elastic Load Balancing service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to load balancers, such as creating, deleting, modifying, and describing load balancer resources.

classes.name: ElasticLoadBalancingClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Elastic Load Balancing service, providing methods to manage load balancers.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds one or more tags to a specified load balancer.

methods.name: applySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
methods.description: Associates security groups with the load balancer.

methods.name: attachLoadBalancerToSubnets
methods.description: Associates one or more subnets with an existing load balancer.

methods.name: configureHealthCheck
methods.description: Configures health check settings for a load balancer.

methods.name: describeLoadBalancers
methods.description: Returns details of all or specified load balancers.
